original_decisions.title: release: prepare @crowsi/provider-http-transport 0.10.1 for OIDC staging
original_decisions.body:
Prepare the next patch version for token-free OIDC staged publication. Keep the reviewed implementation, dependencies, peer requirements, exports and licenses unchanged. Ship the reviewed English README.md and Japanese README.ja.md. Where necessary, extend the existing package checker by exactly README.ja.md at the package root; keep all other checks. Align the exact version/TGZ identity in existing release gates, preparation, archive binding and verification workflows.

Validation on the final composed source: fresh HOME/cache/store, existing release prepare scripts including tests/typecheck/build/pack, independent npm/pnpm archive consumer as applicable, exact archive binding/verification, automated TGZ scan (zero unresolved findings) and independent read-only final-diff review passed. GitHub required checks must pass before normal merge.

Existing stage-only workflow explicitly selects prepare/bootstrap/oidc; OIDC receives no long-lived npm token and has no token fallback. New tag and approval/environment gates are configured separately only after verified merge. CI stages only; the owner performs npm Web formal Approve and 2FA. No credentials, secrets, dependency/runtime or branch-protection changes in this PR.

Candidate Git tree: 18da37a66553067c6b7502587c695aea3cf8de11.

original_decisions.body:
Separate successful lifecycle output from the JSON consumed by release binding with --foreground-scripts=false on npm pack. One helper line only; prepack still executes. Independent review verified successful hook execution, failure propagation and downstream stop, real19-test/type/build pack, JSON parse, byte-identical TGZ and prepare/verify binding. Pinned npm11.12.1; no product, manifest, lock, archive or stage authentication changes. User explicitly approved this exact fix and new-source stage preparation.

original_decisions.title: build: adopt strict TypeScript and stage reviewed npm release
original_decisions.body:
Retain the reviewed strict TypeScript implementation and Node22/24 matrix. Rename its matrix job to verify and require both successes through a test aggregate matching the existing protected check; do not change protection rules.

Stage the already inspected same-run npm archive for owner review; do not promote it from CI. Pin the publishing CLI to npm11.15.0, preserve Node24.15.0, public-source/tag/gates, artifact id/digest verification, Environment and existing NPM_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN name. Record stage response and source/name/version/SHA256/run/artifact in Step Summary. Owner downloads and compares staged bytes before npmjs Staged Packages approval with personal 2FA.

Validation: independent exact-diff review found no mandatory defect; actionlint, syntax, pipeline success/failure fixtures and archive-before-send rejection fixtures passed. Public workflow changes only; product manifest/lock/licenses/build helpers unchanged. Initial stage creates an explicitly user-approved public 0.0.0-stage placeholder; intended release remains pending owner approval. No credentials, trust or protection change in this PR.

Candidate tree: 990e4f7e99a11a4c6eacf463bac6865b9524edb3.
